label: Expected via failures
subgoals: Model each via as failing independently with probability p
Multiply the via count by p to get expected failures
Read the expected count as a yield risk

label: Doubling vias
subgoals: Assign probability p squared to a doubled via
Weight single and doubled vias by their shares
Sum to get the expected number of opens

label: Via-limited yield
subgoals: Raise one minus p to the number of single vias
Multiply by the doubled vias' survival probability
Compare the yield with and without doubling
